
---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or modifying the Pennywise personal finance and budgeting website.
---

1. Brand the product as "Pennywise" with the tagline "Take control of your money." Maintain a premium, modern fintech identity.

2. Use a friendly, confident and financially responsible tone. Keep language simple, clear and encouraging.

3. Use forest green (#142820), sage green (#547C60), warm cream (#F5F3EC), soft gold (#D6B878) and white (#FFFFFF).

4. Use Manrope for headings and DM Sans for body text. Maintain consistent typography, spacing and rounded components.

5. The dashboard must display monthly income, total expenses, available balance and budget utilisation.

6. Include a transaction management section where users can add, view and delete income and expenses.

7. Include spending categories, category-wise breakdowns and visual charts showing where money is being spent.

8. Include a monthly budget planner where users can set spending limits, monitor progress and identify overspending.

9. Display all monetary values in Pakistani Rupees using "Rs." and comma-separated thousands. Use DD MMM YYYY for dates and show percentages to one decimal place.

10. Make the website responsive, accessible and interactive. Persist user data using browser localStorage. Never use fake transaction data as actual user records or claim that a transaction has been saved when it has not.
